### All-in-One Starter Tool Kit Comparison (Budget $75 – $200)

To evaluate kits capable of realistically handling **apartment setup, basic home fixes, furniture assembly, and light car/bike work**, 12 kits across 5 major brands (**Kobalt, CRAFTSMAN, Husky, Crescent, and DEWALT**) were analyzed from live product pages and specifications at Lowe’s, The Home Depot, and Amazon.

---

### Detailed Comparison of the 12 Tool Kits

#### 1. Kobalt 228-Piece Household Tool Set with Hard Case
* **Brand & Retailer:** Kobalt (Lowe's Item #6543287 / Model #55287)
* **Listed Price:** $164.00
* **Fulfillment:** Free store pickup & free standard parcel delivery.
* **Piece Count vs. Real Tools:** 228 headline pieces. Includes 100-pc hardware kit (wall anchors/screws/nails) and 66 driver/precision bits and hex keys. The remaining **62 pieces are durable hand tools**: 16 oz fiberglass hammer, 4 pliers (8" groove-joint, 6" long-nose, 6" slip-joint, 6" diagonal cutters), 6" adjustable wrench, 8.5" wire stripper, 8" heavy-duty scissors, 25 ft extra-wide tape measure, retractable utility knife with 3 blades, 9" magnetic torpedo level, magnetic stud finder, universal combination wrench, magnetic bit driver handle, 4 full-size screwdrivers, 10-in-1 precision screwdriver, two 90-tooth quick-release ratchets (1/4" and 3/8" drive), 40 SAE & metric sockets, 2 extension bars, and 3 adapters.

The set includes 1/4 inch, 3/8 inch, and 1/2 inch quick release ratcheting drives with a wide selection of standard and deep sockets in the most common SAE and metric sizes. Included in the set are the following 3/8 inch drive tools: a 72 tooth quick release ratchet drive, 2 extensions, a 3/8 inch to 1/4 inch adapter, 2 spark plug sockets, 25 twelve point sockets and 10 six point deep sockets (SAE and metric). ### All-in-One Starter Tool Kit Comparison (Budget $75 – $200)

To evaluate kits capable of realistically handling **apartment setup, basic home fixes, furniture assembly, and light car/bike work**, 12 kits across 5 major brands (**Kobalt, CRAFTSMAN, Husky, Crescent, and DEWALT**) were analyzed from live product pages and specifications at Lowe’s, The Home Depot, and Amazon.

---

### Detailed Comparison of the 12 Tool Kits

#### 1. Kobalt 228-Piece Household Tool Set with Hard Case
* **Brand & Retailer:** Kobalt (Lowe's Item #6543287 / Model #55287)
* **Listed Price:** $164.00
* **Fulfillment:** Free store pickup & free standard parcel delivery.
* **Piece Count vs. Real Tools:** 228 headline pieces. Includes 100-pc hardware kit (wall anchors/screws/nails) and 66 driver/precision bits and hex keys. The remaining **62 pieces are durable hand tools**: 16 oz fiberglass hammer, 4 pliers (8" groove-joint, 6" long-nose, 6" slip-joint, 6" diagonal cutters), 6" adjustable wrench, 8.5" wire stripper, 8" heavy-duty scissors, 25 ft extra-wide tape measure, retractable utility knife with 3 blades, 9" magnetic torpedo level, magnetic stud finder, universal combination wrench, magnetic bit driver handle, 4 full-size screwdrivers, 10-in-1 precision screwdriver, two 90-tooth quick-release ratchets (1/4" and 3/8" drive), 40 SAE & metric sockets, 2 extension bars, and 3 adapters.
* **Obvious Gaps:** No locking pliers (Vise-Grips); socket assortment is shallow only (no deep sockets for recessed automotive studs or spark plugs).
* **Warranty:** Kobalt Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee (walk-in exchange at any Lowe’s customer service desk, no questions asked).
* **Case Organization:** Heavy-duty blow-molded chest featuring **2 independent slide-out drawers** with designated tool wells and a top storage compartment, preventing tools from scattering.
* **Brand Ecosystem & Replacements:** Exceptional at Lowe’s; open-stock sockets, ratchets, and individual hand tools are readily stocked in every store.

---

#### 2. Kobalt 183-Piece Household Tool Set with Folding Case
* **Brand & Retailer:** Kobalt (Lowe's Item #5015723993 / Model #55286)
* **Listed Price:** $79.00 (discounted from $109.00)
* **Fulfillment:** Free store pickup & free parcel shipping.
* **Piece Count vs. Real Tools:** 183 headline pieces. Contains 100-pc hardware kit, 30 screwdriver bits, and 16 hex keys. Real tools (**37 primary tools**) include a 13 oz fiberglass hammer, 3 pliers (6" long-nose, 6" slip-joint, 6" diagonal), 6" adjustable wrench, 16 ft tape measure, utility knife with 3 blades, 9" magnetic torpedo level, 8" scissors, magnetic stud finder, 6 full screwdrivers, bit driver, one 3/8" drive 90-tooth ratchet, 14 3/8"-drive 6-point sockets, 3" extension, and drill adapter.
* **Obvious Gaps:** No locking pliers; no groove-joint (plumbing) pliers; only one ratchet (3/8" only, lacks 1/4" drive for tight bicycle/electronics work); only 14 sockets (no deep sockets); no precision screwdrivers; shorter 16 ft tape measure.
* **Warranty:** Kobalt Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee.
* **Case Organization:** Bi-fold plastic clamshell case with tension clips.
* **Brand Ecosystem & Replacements:** Readily available at Lowe’s.

---

#### 3. Kobalt 302-Piece Mechanics Tool Set with Hard Case

* **Warranty:** Kobalt Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee.
* **Case Organization:** 2-drawer blow-molded chest with top lid compartment.
* **Brand Ecosystem & Replacements:** Readily available at Lowe’s.

* **Listed Price:** $149.00
* **Fulfillment:** Free store pickup & free delivery.

High tool density: 84 sockets across 1/4" and 3/8" drives with comprehensive standard and deep depth variety, 3 low-profile 72-tooth ratchets (1/4", 3/8", 1/2"), 8 combination wrenches, magnetic bit driver handle, 42 specialty bits, 14 hex keys, extensions, and universal joint.
